title: Asynchronous programming (async and await)
summary: C# async is a language transformation over Task and ValueTask: you write sequential statements, the compiler builds an IAsyncStateMachine, and I/O completions resume you without occupying a thread. This module covers TAP, exceptions, cancellation, ConfigureAwait, IAsyncEnumerable, TaskCompletionSource, sync-over-async deadlocks, and how Tasks compare to JavaScript Promises.
